chunks.text_original: From Figure 8, it can be seen that all tables produce accuracy of detection better than 67%. Tables with fully or partially bounding lines show higher accuracy with 82.7% of detection compared to the others. These type of tables can be extracted easily as it is bounded with at least single vertical line and we compare their line height with the threshold to eliminate big headings. Therefore, they yield higher accuracy due to the vertical rule line information.
